question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 4, 17, 8 ,21 ,16, 25 ?
solution:
**Logic : Both addition and multiplication pattern is followed here.**

 
• Addition pattern → (4) is added to each number alternately starting with first number in the series.
 
• Multiplication pattern → Each number is multiplied by (2) alternately starting with second number in the series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/542d3a9d85e5761960a9f536f015739035ee70fb804b6ab081852a58123ebe8e.png] 

Hence, **"32"** is the correct answer.
